name: ai-leaders-curation
description: 精选100位AI时代最值得关注的领袖人物 | 每日9:00 AM自动推送

scripts.validate: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const data = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('data/ai-leaders.json', 'utf8')); console.log('✅ JSON valid. Leaders:', data.leaders.length);"
scripts.stats: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const data = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('data/ai-leaders.json', 'utf8')); const stats = { total: data.leaders.length, founders: data.leaders.filter(l => l.category === 'founder').length, executives: data.leaders.filter(l => l.category === 'executive').length, entrepreneurs: data.leaders.filter(l => l.category === 'entrepreneur').length, researchers: data.leaders.filter(l => l.category === 'researcher').length, product_leaders: data.leaders.filter(l => l.category === 'product_leader').length, withInterviews: data.leaders.filter(l => l.interviews && l.interviews.length > 0).length }; console.log('📊 Database Statistics:'); console.log('Total:', stats.total); console.log('Founders:', stats.founders); console.log('Executives:', stats.executives); console.log('Entrepreneurs:', stats.entrepreneurs); console.log('Researchers:', stats.researchers); console.log('Product Leaders:', stats.product_leaders); console.log('With Interviews:', stats.withInterviews);"
